column3: “Speak to the heart” is rendered “Speak kindly,” and “service” as “warfare”; “has been accepted” as “has been removed.”
The line division differs: “in the wilderness” goes with “Clear the way.”
The future is rendered as wishes, “Let every valley be lifted up,” and “steep place” as “rough ground.”
“Its loyalty” is rendered “its loveliness,” and NASB has “he answered” for “he said.”
“Bearer of news of Zion” is rendered “O Zion, bearer of good news.”
“In a strong one” is rendered “with might.”
“In a third of a measure” is rendered “by the measure.”
“Even not” is rendered “Scarcely,” and NASB adds “merely.”
“Justice” is rendered “the justice due me,” and “passes away” as “escapes the notice.”
